deadline.value: Studentship deadline Jan 31 (year inferred as 2027 for October 2027 start); this also applies to CSC and College scholarships. No separate funding application for UKRI or UofG studentships.
deadline.quote: The Application deadline for all studentships is 31 January, for PhDs starting in October of any given year. | There is no separate funding application for UKRI or UofG studentships.

also.quote: If you wish to apply for a CSC Scholarship or a College Scholarship, your application must be submitted by 31st January.

app_fee.quote: We do not charge any application fee, unlike some Universities in other countries

fee_waiver.quote: We do not charge any application fee, unlike some Universities in other countries

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT tests from Jan 21, 2026: 92 overall, no subtest below 4.5; tests up to Jan 20, 2026: 90 overall (R20, L19, S19, W21). IELTS Academic 6.5 with no subtest under 6.0. Single test, taken within 2 years 5 months of the start.
toefl_min.quote: Tests taken up to 20 January 2026 | 90 Overall, no subtest lower than Reading 20; Listening 19; Speaking 19; Writing 21 | Tests taken from 21 January 2026 | 92 Overall, no subtest lower than 4.5 | 6.5 with no subtests under 6.0

english_waiver.value: The only alternatives to a test are a degree from a UKVI majority-English-speaking country (final undergraduate year or 9 months of a master's studied there, within 6 years) or a UK university degree taught at an overseas campus. An English-medium Indian degree is not listed.
english_waiver.quote: Alternatives to English Language qualification | Degree from majority-English speaking country (as defined by the UKVI including Canada if taught in English) | Students must have studied for a minimum of their final year at Undergraduate level, or 9 months at Master's level, and must have completed their degree in that majority-English speaking country within 6 years of programme start. | TNE degree for UK University taught at a campus outside of the UK.

supervisor.value: The School says all applicants should contact potential supervisors before applying, and the application must name a potential supervisor. Agreement from the supervisor is not stated as a condition.
supervisor.quote: Do I need to contact supervisors before applying? | Yes, all applicants should contact potential supervisors to discuss Research topics and available positions before submitting an application. | Applicants must input the name of a potential supervisor in their application.

funding.value: Most studentships are UKRI (EPSRC, STFC) and primarily for those meeting UK residency rules; other scholarships (e.g. CSC, College scholarships) exist. The School's STFC scholarships are open to international applicants, with the number varying.
funding.quote: Some of these are provided by the UK research and innovation (primarily STFC and EPSRC) ... and are primarily designed for those who fill UK residency requirements, but other scholarships are available

also.quote: Open to Home, EU and International applicants. | Number of Scholarships | Varies

entry_route.value: Normally a 2:1 BSc/Honours degree or equivalent, with a significant physics component
entry_route.quote: Applicants for research degrees are normally expected to have obtained or expect to obtain a 2.1 BSc/Honours degree or equivalent.

also.quote: Our regular standard of admission is usually a 2.1 honours degree, with a significant component in Physics or other relevant subjects.

notes: 2027/28 international PhD tuition is listed as £33,708 per year. Personal statements and research proposals are optional; naming a supervisor matters more. The required-documents list includes an "Indian Backlog (if applicable)" item.
